node.statement: The functional phi is 1-Lipschitz for the l1 metric, and the row-geometry part of def-signed-idempotent gives ||p_v-p_j||_1<=D:=2+4*delta for all rows. Therefore t_j:=H-phi(p_j)=phi(p_v)-phi(p_j) satisfies t_j<=D; the preceding distance comparison gives t_j>=0 for all j and t_j>=H-a*tau for j notin G_a.
